Self-hosted reading tools and library forensics by **felixapel**.
### 🛡️ Calibre Bookwarden Content-grounded metadata verification and cover forensics guardian for Calibre libraries. The book file is the ground truth, LLMs are witnesses. Includes read-only 360° forensic audits, swipeable Cover Deck triage UI, Series Gap Hunter, multi-format duplicate consolidation, and sealed cryptographic proofs. * **Template:** `calibre-bookwarden.xml` * **WebUI:** http://[IP]:8080/ * **Repository:** [GitHub](https://github.com/felixapel/calibre-bookwarden)
### 🌐 Book Translator Hub Universal, zero-wait bilingual reading overlay and real-time translation engine for [Calibre-Web-Automated](https://github.com/crocodilestick/Calibre-Web-Automated), [Kavita](https://www.kavitareader.com/), and self-hosted ebook libraries. Features real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming (~160ms TTFT), parallel micro-batches, directional lookahead prefetch, high-capacity IndexedDB offline caching, auto-detect source language, and sub-millisecond SQLite WAL persistence. Supports local LLMs (vLLM / Ollama / Bifrost) and leading cloud providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Groq). * **Template:** `book-translator-hub.xml` * **WebUI (Proxy):** http://[IP]:8385/ * **API Port:** 8390 * **Repository:** [GitHub](https://github.com/felixapel/book-translator-hub)
**Support:** * Calibre Bookwarden: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/felixapel/calibre-bookwarden/issues) * Book Translator Hub: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/felixapel/book-translator-hub/issues) * Contact: felixguillermoapel@gmail.com
